messages.subject: Bayesian SEM summer week course
parts:
Hi all

I will be teaching this summer (June 13-17) a week long course on Bayesian SEM. You can find the detailed information on the website http://www.statscamp.org/advanced-sem

The course intend to be an general introduction the the application of SEM from the Bayesian framework. It will show the application into several common and uncommon SEM models.

The course will support examples in Stan and JAGS, as mayor general Bayesian programs. Also will be working with blavaan, a R package that implements lavaan syntax while running the models in JAGS. 

Hope this will be of interest to some of you, or if you know somebody that may be interested please pass along the information


-- Mauricio
